rows.label: Norwegian Refugee Council total costs, 2025 (kroner)

source.title: Norwegian Refugee Council, Annual Accounts 2025 (audited by BDO; year to 31 December 2025)

rows.explainer: Direct humanitarian costs NOK 7,934.7m, project support NOK 470.6m, administration NOK 71.0m and fundraising NOK 224.2m. NRC's representation offices in Germany, Sweden, Switzerland, Belgium, the UK and the USA are included (note 1). Read by both of charityevals' NRC models for the overhead multiplier and the staff share.
